home.icebreakersBody: Before each meetup we'll pair you up for a quick 1:1 chat with someone from the cohort. By the end of the year, everyone knows everyone.
home.aboutLead: Weekly meetups with founders, investors and AI leaders from the industry. Hands-on workshops. A community that builds.
home.about1Body: Founders, investors and AI leaders from the industry, every Wednesday.
home.about2Body: Zero to Hero: laptops open, and you leave with something that runs.
home.about3Body: A small cohort, about 40 places, and initiatives members take on for the club.
home.bandInBody: Your profile, your meetups and the workshop materials are in your personal area.
home.bandOutBody: Follow us for open events and to hear first when the next cohort opens.

attendance.title: Attendance from Luma
attendance.body: After the meetup, open the event on Luma → Guests → Export CSV and upload the file here, or upload the attendee PDF from the automation. Members are matched by any of their emails. Guests who aren't members are only counted: their names and emails are never saved.

attendance.pickAfter: After the session: who came, from Luma (CSV or PDF)
attendance.uploadsBody: Each session gets two uploads of the Luma list: before it, who registered (that's how the pAIr get-to-know game knows who's coming), and after it, who actually came (for attendance). Same file, same way; the site tells which one it is by the time.
attendance.pickHint: Read in your browser; only email, registration status and check-in time are sent. Uploading again replaces this event's attendance.

attendance.unmatchedBody: Only club members come to sessions, so each row here is most likely a member who registered on Luma with another email. Picking the member saves that email with them, for matching attendance only and not for signing in, and every later upload recognises them. This list isn't saved: it's gone when you leave the page.
